## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the **Product Constitution** (trust over traffic, never guess, one fact/one home).
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally (typecheck · lint · format · unit tests).
- [ ] No atomic fact is hardcoded/duplicated (it lives in a single source).
- [ ] No server secret is exposed to the client (`NEXT_PUBLIC_` boundary respected).
- [ ] Trust metadata (source, verified date, applicability) preserved where applicable.
- [ ] Tests added/updated for new logic.
- [ ] Accessibility considered (keyboard, contrast, semantics) for UI changes.
- [ ] Docs/ADR updated if an architectural decision changed.
